columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier.   Populated automatically for Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud services customers by the Load Interface File for Import program.  Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: process identifier for the Import Intercompany Transactions process.

columns.name: DIST_ID
columns.description: Distribution identifier.   Populated automatically for Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud services customers by the Load Interface File for Import program.  Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: BATCH_DIST_ID
columns.description: Batch distribution identifier.   Populated automatically for Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud services customers by the Load Interface File for Import program.  Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: DIST_NUMBER
columns.description: Distribution number.  Must be unique for the transaction and party type.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Party identifier. Populated by the interface import program.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Party type option. Valid values: I, R. I means distribution line is for the provider. R means distribution line is for the receiver.

columns.name: DIST_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Distribution type option. Use: L. Means distribution line is for provider.

columns.name: AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Credit amount for the distribution line.  Total debits and credits must balance per provider and per receiver.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Debit amount. Total debits and credits must balance per provider and per receiver.

columns.name: CCID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier.  Use the Manage Account Combinations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
